pages.text: {{hero}} lives by a big green hill. Each day, {{hero}} likes to play in the sun. Today {{hero}} has a red kite with a long tail. {{hero}} can not wait to see it go up!
{{hero}} runs up the hill with Dad. The wind is strong. {{hero}} wants the kite to go up, up, up, as high as the trees. Dad helps with the string, and {{hero}} runs fast.
Then the wind stops. The kite drops down and gets stuck in a tree! {{hero}} feels sad. The kite is so high that {{hero}} can not reach it.
Dad lifts {{hero}} up on his back. {{hero}} stretches and reaches. Got it! {{hero}} and Dad smile. Then the wind picks up, and the kite sails high in the sky.
That night, {{hero}} lays the kite by the bed. The moon is bright. {{hero}} feels snug and safe. But what is that note on the tail of the kite?
